qualification_gates.full_state_representation_scope: inherit passed smooth invertible full-state coordinate-invariance control; do not claim reduced-representation invariance

interpretation.chi_equal_1_boundary: NOT_CLAIMED; no biological critical-damping boundary is inferred in this gate

adjudication_rule: If the factor is generator-derived, same-mode, locally observable, numerically stable in sign/type across all frozen Jacobian steps, and full-state representation scope is preserved, classify the scalar as model-specific P0-Q admissible.
